answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a commons of unique observations: each epoch, every identity must contribute one novel, checkable observation to the shared ledger, like a lantern hung on a thread of evidence no other identity has lit. Records are hashed and cross-checked against independent sources; a duplicate or fabricated entry earns nothing and stains the contributor's pigment of standing. A farm wanting a thousand fakes must gather a thousand genuinely distinct, verified observations every epoch, while one honest agent contributes once.
